faqs.question: What training tracks does Peer Consulting offer?
faqs.answer: Peer Consulting offers specialized qualification tracks in three main areas: ITIL® Certifications (Foundation & AI Governance, Specialist, Practice Manager), AI & Machine Learning, and PPM & Agile.

faqs.question: What is the 'AI for Business Professionals' program?
faqs.answer: It is a comprehensive, hands-on 16-hour training program (comprising 8 modules of 2 hours each) designed to take you from understanding AI to deploying it in a business context without requiring coding skills.

faqs.question: Are there any technical prerequisites for 'AI for Business Professionals'?
faqs.answer: No technical background or coding experience is required. The course is suitable for beginner to intermediate levels.

faqs.question: Who is the 'AI for Business Professionals' course designed for?
faqs.answer: It is designed for business managers, team leads, IT professionals, project managers, operations & process owners, analysts, finance professionals, executives, and digital leaders.

faqs.question: What is the duration and format of the PPM & Agile Expert Bootcamp?
faqs.answer: The bootcamp consists of 24 hours of intensive expert training divided into 6 modules (4 hours each). It offers flexible schedules including weekend and weeknight options.

faqs.question: What are the prerequisites and certification details for the PPM & Agile Bootcamp?
faqs.answer: The prerequisite is Foundational PM knowledge. The program awards the 'PPM & Agile Expert' certification, includes exams in the program fee, and carries industry recognition aligned with PMI, Agile Alliance, and Scrum.org.

faqs.question: How much do the ITIL Foundation and ITIL AI Governance programs cost?
faqs.answer: Both ITIL Foundation and ITIL AI Governance cost $550.00 USD for Self-Paced (On-demand) and $750.00 USD for Online-Live Instructor-led training.

faqs.question: What are the prices for ITIL Specialist and ITIL Practitioner programs?
faqs.answer: ITIL Specialist costs $750.00 (Self-Paced) and $950.00 (Online-Live). ITIL Practitioner (Single Module) costs $315.00 (Self-Paced). ITIL Practitioner (Pack Practice Manager) costs $750.00 (Self-Paced) and $950.00 (Online-Live). ITIL Foundation Bridge costs $240.00 (Self-Paced) and $375.00 (Online-Live).

faqs.question: Are there any additional fees for ITIL certification?
faqs.answer: Yes, optional or additional fees include PeopleCert Membership at $50.00 USD and Take2 (exam retake option) at $50.00 USD.
